descriptions.notStarted: Porchay, who stays with the Whalians in the Generator Room, says that there is an emergency. I wonder what it is?
descriptions.inProgress: I can't believe that the Whalians have completely run out of food! According to Porchay, Kenta has plenty of food ingredients so I should go to #bKenta#k and talk to her. I should take Porchay's letter with me too, right?
descriptions.completed: I gave Porchay's letter to Kenta.
